media.alt: A 19 second walk through the empty former DMV that is becoming Fore Motion Golf. Owner Justin Myrick walks along a long service counter wall where the four bays go, with one arm out toward the wall. The video cuts to a 3D concept view, labeled Concept, pushing into a finished simulator bay with a golfer on the tee mat and a golf course on the screen, then back to Justin in the open hall. On screen: Owner Justin Myrick walks the space. Four bays go here. The bays, as planned. Opening early 2027. Follow the build. Join the Founders List. The Fore Motion Golf logo is at the top and foremotiongolf.com at the foot throughout.

Owner Justin Myrick walks along a long service counter in the empty former DMV, one arm out toward the wall, under numbered window signs. The Fore Motion Golf logo sits at the top, and a deep green panel below reads Owner Justin Myrick walks the space. Four bays go here. foremotiongolf.com.
